[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] CyrusOne was founded in July 2000 by David Ferdman and Larry Bursten, who had previously built companies acquired by IXC Communications. The company was purchased by Cincinnati Bell for 525 million dollars in 2010, completed an IPO in 2013, and was taken private again in 2022 when Kohlberg Kravis Roberts and Global Infrastructure Partners acquired it for 15 billion dollars. Sourcing fetched this session gave detailed acquisition stories for several CyrusOne markets, including Texas, Virginia, Ohio, Arizona, Illinois, and Connecticut, but did not contain a specific opening date, investment figure, or building history for this particular state cluster.
